capabilities: Render notes with date frontmatter as bars on a Gantt timeline
Drag bars to reschedule tasks and update frontmatter dates
Set task progress by dragging a handle on each bar
Filter the chart by status, project, folder, and required property
Change task status from a bar's right-click menu
extras: Desktop only for now, per the README's limitations section; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see date-based task notes on a timeline or reschedule them by dragging.

relations.evidence: Built with TypeScript and esbuild on top of Frappe Gantt (MIT).

summary: Gantt chart view that renders notes with date frontmatter as a draggable timeline and writes reschedules back to the notes.
